headline: Earnings fall sharply on margin compression
summary_short: PSEG's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $2,554M (-33.6% q/q, -8.9% y/y) and diluted EPS fell to $0.67 from $1.17 a year ago (-42.7% y/y), with net income down to $334M (-42.9% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue fell 33.6% q/q and 8.9% y/y to $2,554M. Gross margin was 30.6%, down from 36.5% q/q and 40.1% y/y. Operating margin fell to 18.0% from 27.9% q/q and 29.1% y/y. Diluted EPS declined to $0.67, down 54.7% q/q and 42.7% y/y, on net income of $334M (-42.9% y/y) and EBITDA of $1,042M (-21.7% y/y). Cash fell to $192M (-52.5% q/q, +3.2% y/y); long-term debt rose 4.2% y/y to $23,591M against equity of $17,329M (+3.9% y/y).
